lines.text: Many learners say: Please open the light.
Better: Please turn on the light.
Open is for doors. For lights, turn on.
Turn on! Please turn on the music.

data.why: Open is for doors. For lights, turn on.

native.tip: open 用来开门；开灯、开音乐要用 “turn on”。
native.caption: 你会说 “Please open the light” 吗？🙈 在英语里 open 是开门、开盖子，开灯要说 “Please turn on the light”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“turn on”。开灯、开音乐都用 turn on！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Open is for doors. For lights and music, use “turn on”.
en.caption: Do you say “Please open the light”? 🙈 In English, open is for doors and lids. For a light, say “Please turn on the light”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
